## What does the same token workload cost? {#sc-compare-llm-cost .fv-slide .sc-slide .sc-compare background-color="#ffffff"}

```{=html}
<div class="fv-meta"><span class="fv-id">S 28 / 95</span><span class="fv-cluster active">LLM</span><span class="fv-cluster">Text-to-image</span><span class="fv-cluster">Text-to-video</span><span class="fv-cluster">Text-to-speech</span><span class="fv-cluster">Music</span><a class="sc-back" href="#/sc-toc">All models ↗</a></div>
<div class="sc-body cmp-body cmp-rows-6">
<p class="cmp-intro">100K billed input tokens + 10K billed output tokens · October 2026 API prices in USD</p>
<table class="cmp-table" aria-label="What does the same token workload cost?"><colgroup><col style="width:22%"><col style="width:19%"><col style="width:14%"><col style="width:45%"></colgroup><thead><tr><th scope="col">Model</th><th scope="col">Input / output<br>per 1M tokens</th><th scope="col">Example cost</th><th scope="col">What changes the bill?</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><th scope="row"><a href="#sc-llm-sonnet-55">Sonnet 5.5</a></th><td>$2 / $10</td><td><strong>$0.30</strong></td><td>Batch is a separate mode; default effort: high.</td></tr><tr><th scope="row"><a href="#sc-llm-gpt61-sol">GPT-6.1 Sol</a></th><td>$2 / $10</td><td><strong>$0.30</strong></td><td>Cached input: $0.10/M; default effort: medium.</td></tr><tr><th scope="row"><a href="#sc-llm-opus-55">Opus 5.5</a></th><td>$4 / $20</td><td><strong>$0.60</strong></td><td>Cached input: $0.20/M; default effort: medium.</td></tr><tr><th scope="row"><a href="#sc-llm-gpt6-astra">GPT-6 Astra</a></th><td>$10 / $50</td><td><strong>$1.50</strong></td><td>Fast mode doubles price; this example becomes $3.00.</td></tr><tr><th scope="row"><a href="#sc-llm-fable-51">Fable 5.1</a></th><td>$10 / $50</td><td><strong>$1.50</strong></td><td>Thinking stays on; default effort: high.</td></tr><tr><th scope="row"><a href="#sc-llm-grok-47">Grok 4.7</a></th><td>$2 / $6</td><td><strong>$0.26</strong></td><td>These rates apply below the 200K threshold.</td></tr></tbody></table>
<p class="cmp-caveat">Cost = 0.1 × input rate + 0.01 × output rate. Token counts include billed reasoning. Tokenizers can assign different counts to the same text.</p>
</div>
<div class="fv-takeaway">At a fixed token volume, Astra costs 5× Sol; equal task cost still depends on token use.</div>
<div class="fv-source">Audit snapshot 18–19.10.2026 · reported results 21.10.2026 · source cards: <a href="#/sc-llm-sonnet-55">1</a> · <a href="#/sc-llm-gpt61-sol">2</a> · <a href="#/sc-llm-opus-55">3</a> · <a href="#/sc-llm-gpt6-astra">4</a> · <a href="#/sc-llm-fable-51">5</a> · <a href="#/sc-llm-grok-47">6</a> · <a href="https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-6.1-sol">Sol API</a> · <a href="https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-6-astra">Astra API</a></div>
```

::: {.notes}
Сравниваем именно одинаковый оплачиваемый объём: 100 тысяч входных и 10 тысяч выходных токенов. Формула даёт $0,30 для Sonnet и Sol, $0,60 для Opus, $1,50 для Astra и Fable и $0,26 для Grok при указанном ценовом пороге. Это расчёт по снимку тарифов, не измеренная стоимость решения задачи. Одинаковый текст может иметь разную токенизацию; reasoning, повторы и вызовы инструментов меняют итоговый счёт. У Astra fast в этом примере $3,00. Попросите студентов назвать, каких данных не хватает для сравнения стоимости одного исправленного бага.

**Evidence scope.** Comparison of the deck's supplied audit and results snapshots. No fresh model execution or current-price verification. Arithmetic and task implications are editorial derivations, not additional benchmark measurements.
